messages:
lee: Heads-up — planning to roll out adaptive SLO thresholds and a priority-queue routing feature next weekend. Dry-run failover + load exercise scheduled Sat 2026-05-16 03:00 UTC. Details below.

nisha: what's "adaptive SLOs"? how does that affect alerts?

lee: short: thresholds will scale with a moving-avg p95 baseline per route. Alerts get a new "suppressed-if-adaptive" flag during baseline recalcs. Expect fewer noisy pages during short sustained bursts.

derek: will this change billing/observability? want to avoid confusing dashboards for PMs

lee: dashboard updates only: new "SLO mode" tag and annotations for adaptive windows. No billing changes. Product/PMs notified earlier.

sre-oncall-bot: Reminder — oncall rota: emily on call for 2026-05-16 00:00-12:00 UTC

emily: I can take the dry-run. can we start with a canary region? not all routes support priority-queue yet.

lee: yes — canary in us-west-2 only. We'll enable priority-queue for model-routing routes only. Initial route list: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings.

nisha: do we have rollback plan? what are the exact cutover steps?

lee: Rollback plan: 1) toggle adaptive-mode=false, 2) drain priority-queue, 3) revert routing-policy via infra flag. I'll paste exact commands below.

lee: commands:
```bash
# canary enable
infractl feature toggle --env prod --region us-west-2 priority-queue=true
infractl feature toggle --env prod --region us-west-2 adaptive-slo=true
# rollback
infractl feature toggle --env prod --region us-west-2 adaptive-slo=false
```

derek: lgtm on commands. I'll add runbook snippets to ops doc and include expected alerts.

lee: runbook PR: https://redwood.internal/ops/slo-adaptive-pr (will add rollback steps + playbook)

emily: what's the expected SLO change? numbers please.

lee: p95 latency target for Std tier remains 200ms. Adaptive window allows threshold to float +/-25% during a sustained burst, with auto-fallthrough to baseline after 10m of stable signals. We'll record annotations for each window.

nisha: will this affect Dedicated customers? need an opt-out flag and comms.

lee: Dedicated customers get opt-out: infra flag `dedicated-adaptive=false` per org. Sales & CSMs notified; internal comms scheduled.

derek: can we run a synthetic traffic pattern tomorrow to validate? recommend ramp 2x -> 5x -> 10x.

lee: synthetic run scheduled Fri 2026-05-15 22:00 UTC. I'll post traffic matrix and top-k routes.

emily: i'll monitor kv-cache hit rate and tail latencies. call out if p999 increases >10%.

lee: thanks. action items: emily monitor during dry-run, derek update runbook, nisha notify PMs & Sales, infra to schedule canary toggle. I'll post final checklist 24h before.

sre-oncall-bot: Incident-ops note: create incident channel if any P0 is triggered during the dry-run.

lee: thanks all. ping me for access to the canary toggle or if you want to rehearse the rollback steps.
